summary: Mere Medical is a self-hosted platform designed to aggregate personal health data from multiple patient portals into a single interface. It operates with an offline-first architecture to keep your medical information under your direct control.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want to consolidate records from various healthcare providers locally without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: Given the moderate development activity and specific focus on niche health portals, integration stability with upstream services may require frequent troubleshooting.
deployNotes: As a Dockerised Node.js application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS connections.
